info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Suitability Assessment API
info.description: The Suitability Assessment API allows financial institutions to evaluate the suitability of products or services for their clients in wholesale trading. Through a PATCH request, users can update the suitability status based on evolving client needs or regulatory requirements. This endpoint is typically used by compliance teams, financial advisors, and trading departments to ensure that investment offerings align with client profiles and risk appetites. The API facilitates efficient management of suitability checks and plays a crucial role in maintaining regulatory compliance.

patch.summary: Update suitability checking for a specific resource.
patch.description: This endpoint allows developers to update the suitability checking status for a given resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the data being sent complies with the required format and validation rules to avoid errors.

requestBody.description: This request body is intended to update the suitability check details for a specific wholesale trading operation identified by RES-100045. The payload contains the necessary data required to modify the existing records associated with the specified operation.
